name: linux-mint-ai-limits-applet
description: Applet Cinnamon e monitor local dos limites de assinatura do Claude Code e Codex no Linux Mint.

scripts.check:gnome: node --check gnome/snapshot.js && node --check gnome/extension.js && node --input-type=module -e 'import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises"; JSON.parse(await readFile("gnome/metadata.json", "utf8"));'
